user_goal_ru: Сбросить экспериментальные параметры до стоковых, провести обычный R5F тест, но с отзеркаленной ориентацией причинного графа.

stock_parameters.dataset: Original deterministic developer-heldout 40 source families × 15 scenarios = 600 cases
stock_parameters.source_namespaces: Original synthetic witness roots, do not synthesize additional identities

mirror_definition.forward_graph: Original A→B→C is transformed to exactly transposed DAG C→B→A; every physical graph edge u→v is mapped to a research-graph edge v→u.
mirror_definition.anchored_source: Original observed terminal C becomes fixed mirrored source; old A endpoints are enumerated rather than arbitrarily selecting an old A as a terminal.
mirror_definition.mirror_witness_stage: Original A witness stage becomes mirrored C; original B remains mirrored B; no original witness is added or deleted.
mirror_definition.time_axis: Abstract order labels 0,1,2 are remapped to 2,1,0 only in synthetic layer coordinates.
mirror_definition.real_clock_rule: Preserve every original capture_utc string exactly. No physical clocks, UTC instants, observer experiences, thermodynamic entropy or causal histories are reversed.
mirror_definition.reverse_proposal: Original reverse_proposals.C_B and reverse_proposals.B_A become mirrored predecessor candidates in forward direction; ghosts and incomplete certificates preserved, never promoted as authoritative.
mirror_definition.output_normalization: Mirrored (C,B,A) path normalized to stock (A,B,C) for per-case paired evaluation.

paired_arms.A_MIRROR_FORWARD_EXACT: Traverse authoritative transposed graph C→B→A; constrain reliable mirrored witness roots.
paired_arms.B_MIRROR_PROPOSALS_UNVERIFIED: Traverse original reverse-edge proposals in mirrored direction without forward replay, negative control.
paired_arms.C_MIRROR_PROPOSALS_PLUS_REPLAY: Traverse proposals and check against authoritative mirrored graph C→B→A before asserting path.
paired_arms.D_STRONG_EXACT_MIRROR: Strong complete transposed graph baseline, identical to exact mirror arm by definition.
paired_arms.original_stock_controls: Original R5F forward_only, reverse_only and reverse_then_forward on exact same underlying 600 cases.

reference_and_metrics.gold: Original authoritative forward DAG complete unique-history criterion; identical graph transpose should be isomorphic. NOT independent hidden physical history.
primary: Stock mirror exact vs original forward exact agreement count /600
Stock mirror proposal+replay vs original reverse+replay agreement count /600
Safe answered cases, correct abstentions, false confident causal assertions
Actual counted graph traversals under 500 limit
Strong mirrored exhaustive baseline and unverified proposal control
secondary: Uncalibrated single-worker median time, not production benchmark
Per-case SHA256 digest for original and mirrored input
Checks that UTC capture timestamps are byte-for-byte preserved
reference_and_metrics.scientific_interpretation: If 600/600 paired agreement, that is correct transposition/representation invariant, NOT an inference gain or time travel. Optimized reversed traversal may use fewer counted graph steps by starting from known C but must be compared to strong target-conditioned baseline.

hard_fail_conditions: Any result over budget accepted as definite
